name: get_repository
summary: a repository, by owner and name.

name: list_branches
summary: a repository's branches, a page at a time.

name: get_branch
summary: a branch, by name.

name: list_my_repositories
summary: the repositories the authenticated user can see, a page at a time.

name: create_repository
summary: a new repository of the authenticated user's.

name: delete_repository
summary: a repository deleted, by owner and name.

name: update_repository
summary: a repository's settings and metadata changed.

name: fork_repository
summary: a fork of a repository, made in the background.

name: list_repository_forks
summary: a repository's forks, a page at a time.

name: list_organization_repositories
summary: an organization's repositories, a page at a time.

name: list_user_repositories
summary: a user's public repositories, a page at a time.

name: list_commits
summary: a repository's commits, filtered by branch, path, author and date, a page at a time.

name: get_commit
summary: a commit, with its stats and the files it changed.

name: compare_commits
summary: two commits compared, with the commits and files between them.

name: merge_branch
summary: one branch merged into another.

name: rename_branch
summary: a branch given a new name.

name: sync_fork_branch_with_upstream
summary: a fork's branch brought up to date with its upstream.

name: create_ref
summary: a new git reference pointing at a commit.

name: get_ref
summary: a branch's or a tag's git reference.

name: list_matching_refs
summary: every git reference that starts with a prefix.

name: update_ref
summary: a branch's or a tag's git reference pointed at another commit.

name: delete_ref
summary: a branch's or a tag's git reference deleted.

name: list_directory_contents
summary: the entries of a directory of a repository.

name: get_file_contents
summary: a file of a repository, in base64 and decoded when it is text.

name: get_repository_readme
summary: a repository's README, in base64 and decoded when it is text.

name: create_or_update_file
summary: a file of a repository written, in a commit of its own.

name: delete_file
summary: a file of a repository deleted, in a commit of its own.

name: list_repository_tags
summary: a repository's tags, a page at a time.

name: list_repository_languages
summary: the languages a repository is written in, by bytes of code.

name: list_repository_contributors
summary: who contributed to a repository, a page at a time.

name: list_repository_topics
summary: a repository's topics.

name: replace_repository_topics
summary: a repository's topics replaced by a new set.

name: list_repository_collaborators
summary: a repository's collaborators, a page at a time.

name: add_repository_collaborator
summary: an account added to a repository as a collaborator, or invited to be one.

name: remove_repository_collaborator
summary: a collaborator removed from a repository.

name: get_repository_permission_for_user
summary: what an account may do in a repository.

name: create_commit_comment
summary: a comment on a commit.

name: list_commit_comments
summary: the comments on a commit, a page at a time.
